title: Onboarding + Kairo-owned Auth/Recovery + Final UI Consistency

notes: Implements UI-07 from issue #94 using the approved Kairo design baseline.
First-run remains two conceptual steps: lightweight Brand setup followed by Brand Brain suggestion review.
Kairo-owned sign-in/recovery surfaces are remediated without changing Auth0 Universal Login or OIDC/provider contracts.
Arbitrary authentication query errors are not reflected back to users; safe local return paths remain bounded.
Vercel Git-triggered deployment remains disabled and this slice has no deployment approval.

approvals.rationale: Owner instructed Go next, authorizing UI-07 onboarding + Kairo-owned auth/recovery + final consistency as the next bounded Kairo remediation slice.
The slice preserves approved Auth0/OIDC security policy and the existing Workspace/Brand creation contract; it changes only Kairo-owned presentation and bounded recovery copy.
Go next authorizes bounded implementation, tests, UI review and exact-head certification gates. Merge and deployment remain separate approvals.
Requires implementation-level UI Review plus Product Intake, Security baseline and CI on one frozen exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: A new user reaches Brand Brain through a simple two-step first-run flow, while Kairo-owned sign-in recovery is calm, safe and visually consistent with the rest of the product.
